_comment: Release notes shown to staff in the 'What's new' popup on first launch after an update. The CI 'Inject build metadata' step picks the TOP entry (latest) and injects its title + bullets into lib/build-info.ts. Add new entries to the TOP. Keep each entry's title under 50 chars and each bullet under 100 chars. Use empty strings or omit fields to skip them.

releases.title: Custom fields, date pickers, file uploads
highlights: Custom Fields section now appears on every record (whatever your admin defined in Settings)
Date and datetime fields use a native calendar picker — no more typing YYYY-MM-DD
Files tab on customers / projects / tasks / leads / invoices — upload from camera, gallery, or any document
Lead status/source and ticket priority/status show as readable labels instead of raw IDs
Searchable picker when editing relations (country, currency, staff, customer, source, status)
